item.title: Sebastião Salgado passes away
item.description: MediaStorm is saddened by the passing of the legendary photojournalist Sebastião Salgado. We had the honor of spending many hours with Salgado while producing a film on his personal journey and remarkable body of work for the ICP Infinity Awards in 2022.

item.title: Case Study: CatchLight’s Impact Report
item.description: CatchLight’s Impact Report details the results of the organization’s mission to cover local communities and create social change. We’ve created a case study that details how we used the MediaStorm Platform and our Creative Services offering to build the site.

item.title: Back from the Brink for Catalina Island Conservancy
item.description: Back from the Brink: Resurgence of the Catalina Island Fox tells the story of one of the greatest conservation successes in United States history. Once teetering on the edge of extinction, the Santa Catalina Island Fox has made a dramatic recovery.

item.title: Documentary series The Darkroom MCs to premiere on June 18th
item.description: A new documentary series, The Darkroom MC's, which showcases the most important underrepresented photographers of our time, will premiere June 18, 2025, on PBS, ALL*ARTS TV and YouTube.

item.title: Faculty Position in Photojournalism, The School of Visual Communication
item.description: The School of Visual Communication (VisCom) at Ohio University invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track position in Photojournalism with a focus in conservation, editorial, or documentary storytelling. This position is part of a strategic interdisciplinary cluster hire that advances Ohio University’s Dynamic Strategy, particularly its commitment to experiential learning, applied research, and alumni engagement.

item.title: Love+War | National Geographic Documentary Films
item.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning conflict photographer Lynsey Addario has changed the way we look at war in the 21st century. Now, for the first time, she steps in front of the lens in an intimate portrait of ambition, responsibility, motherhood, and identity. From Academy Award® winners Chai Vasarhelyi and Jimmy Chin, “Love+War” opens in select US theaters starting October 29. Streaming November 7 on Disney+ and Hulu. #LoveAndWarFilm
